text:
incident-bot: ⚠️ Incident opened: flowgate auth p99 latency spike impacting streaming inference paths — SEV2
oncall-alex: seeing p95 ~220ms, p99 jumping to ~1.2s for streaming tail requests since ~13:07 UTC. Started from a sudden surge.
sre-jordan: confirmed. Graphs show an auth tokenstore uptick, and configfetch latencies rising at same time.
eng-runtime-sam: can you paste the correlation? Is it auth DB or control-plane config fetch?
prod-ops-lee: quick snapshot: auth DB CPU at 85%, connections spiked +3x from baseline. configfetch service 5xx and 504s.
customer-support-maya: we have two enterprise customers reporting slow chat responses and stalled streams, one on EU region. No data loss, but long stalls.
oncall-alex: customer impact: streaming stalls >5s for ~2% of requests, retries causing users to see delays. Need mitigation plan.
sre-jordan: mitigation attempt 1: reduce auth token TTL checks from 5m -> 30m for live requests (hotfix config) to reduce load on tokenstore. Rolling now.
eng-runtime-sam: also enabling prefix KV cache bypass fallback for streaming on older model variants to avoid configfetch synchronous call. Pushing rollout to 10% then 50%.
prod-ops-lee: scaling tokenstore DB read replicas +1 to absorb spikes. Running: `kubectl scale statefulset tokenstore-read  --replicas=3`
oncall-alex: note: be careful about replication lag causing stale token reads. Jordan, monitor.
sre-jordan: watching replication lag — currently <50ms, ok. After scale, p99 dipped to ~800ms.
security-iris: verify TTL change doesn't bypass compliance checks for enterprise customers. Which tenants exempt?
eng-runtime-sam: enterprise flag respects strict auth for flagged orgs — we won't apply TTL relaxation there. Only for default/anonymous paths.
product-ops-lee: added temporary rate limit on configfetch per-caller to 10r/s for non-enterprise callers to reduce thundering herd.
customer-support-maya: notifying affected customers with status update: short stalls, mitigation in progress, ETA 30m.
oncall-alex: logs:
```
2026-03-15T13:08:12Z pipeline: stream request id=abc123 waiting on configfetch (500ms) auth-check (401ms)
2026-03-15T13:08:14Z tokenstore: connections=1024 cpu=85% errs=12
```
eng-runtime-sam: discovered configfetch calls frequently cascade when feature flags eval triggers a remote lookup for per-customer overrides. Turning on local feature flag cache fallback for 100% of streaming routes now.
sre-jordan: after cache fallback and tokenstore scale, p95 ~180ms, p99 ~420ms. Good improvement but not fully resolved.
oncall-alex: still seeing tailers hitting ~900ms intermittently. Might be a downstream rate limiter in edge-auth.
prod-ops-lee: edge-auth rate limiter bumped from 200r/s -> 400r/s for internal infra service accounts. Applied.
security-iris: audit note: changes made are temporary emergency mitigations. Will create a runbook to revert TTL/rate rules post-incident.
eng-runtime-sam: also enabled model-variant fallback for streaming: route to cached quantized variant when configfetch latency >200ms. Applied to canary 20% -> 100% if stable.
sre-jordan: can we force a warm KV cache for common prefixes? Running a short warm-up job to prepopulate hotkeys.
prod-ops-lee: warm-up job kicked off: `python infra/scripts/warm_kv.py --prefixes top1000 --region eu`
oncall-alex: adding handoff note: I'll be oncall until 14:30 UTC then hand to Jordan if still open.
incident-bot: Handoff recorded: oncall-alex -> sre-jordan at 14:30 UTC.
customer-support-maya: updated status: customers reported improved behavior; some still see slow startup but streaming continues after initial delay.
sre-jordan: current metrics: streaming p95 170ms, p99 360ms, error rate back to baseline. Closing mitigation loop but leaving monitoring on 4hr burn.
security-iris: reminder: collect all changed config keys and emergency flags to a ticket for postmortem and compliance review.
oncall-alex: root cause hypothesis: sudden tenant-level feature-flag churn + auth token churn caused cascading configfetchs + tokenstore hot-shard. Fixes: longer-term: per-tenant featureflag caching, tokenstore sharding + autoscale, smarter backpressure on control-plane calls.
eng-runtime-sam: will open PRs for featureflag cache and configfetch circuit breakers.
prod-ops-lee: ops tasks: scale tokenstore autoscaler, add read capacity headroom, review rate-limiter defaults.
customer-support-maya: sending final customer note: "We saw transient stalls affecting a small subset of streaming requests. Mitigations deployed; service returning to normal. Follow-up PM with timeline to come."
oncall-alex: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Will document timeline and assign postmortem owners.
incident-bot: Incident updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity downshifted to SEV3.
eng-runtime-sam: assigning postmortem owner: @eng-runtime-sam. ETA draft in 72h.
security-iris: filing compliance ticket and tagging customers with stricter auth into exempt list so TTL/hotfix doesn't affect them.
onsignature: thread end."
